selection_rationale: Higher-impression first-page-boundary candidates were materially optimized on 2026-09-01 and remain inside their measurement windows. This was the highest-position independent unworked candidate in the raw current 28-day GSC extraction.

baseline.source: Google Search Console Search Analytics API

query_subset_page_baseline.method: Rows from the same query-page-country-device extraction whose selected page is the target canonical; not a pure page-dimension total.

experiment_isolation.last_page_change_scope: One contextual outbound link to /kabul-ne-demek only

serp_observation.method: Limited web-search snapshot, not a personalized Google rank measurement
serp_observation.dominant_intent: Informational definition with ACT context, everyday examples and short-term-relief/long-term-cost explanation
serp_observation.observed_gap: The existing page lacked visible authorship and recency, verified sources, a precise answer-first definition, varied everyday examples and a bounded self-observation procedure.

acceptance_contract: Keep the existing URL and exact canonical
Lead with a concise definition covering unwanted private experiences and rigid control or avoidance efforts
Distinguish protective avoidance from inflexible experiential avoidance by context and function
Add everyday examples without treating them as diagnostic signs
Provide a four-step observation procedure with explicit safety and professional-assessment boundaries
Explain the ACT and psychological-flexibility relationship without guaranteed outcomes
Show author, publication date, update date, editorial boundary and verified sources
Align Article citation, dateModified and speakable with visible content
Keep visible FAQ answers identical to FAQPage JSON-LD
Track both CTA surfaces through consent-gated generic analytics markers
Add one contextual inbound link from the stable ACT overview
Update sitemap lastmod and complete-tier daily P0 query monitoring

evaluation.low_volume_caution: A single new impression or isolated rank observation is insufficient to declare a win.
